6:00 P.M.

www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
For record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR LACKEY, DIRECTORS DISPENZA, HOFBAUER, AND THOMPSON
3. CLOSED SESSION - PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
4. PRESENTATION BY GENERAL COUNSEL of the following items to be discussed in Closed Session:
4.1 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the Agency's legal counsel and to receive direction from the Successor Agency regarding a significant exposure to litigation against the Agency. Closed session is recommended because the Agency will assess the merits of this matter and consider the Agency's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances, there is a significant exposure to litigation against the Agency. The existing facts and circumstances that might result in litigation against the Agency are not yet known to a potential plaintiff or plaintiffs, and therefore need not be disclosed. Based on the existing facts and circumstances, it is the opinion of the General Counsel that it would prejudice the position of the Agency to discuss this matter in public or to disclose further the circumstances in this potential case. Further, such disclosure may harm any settlement attempts or other efforts to resolve the matter without litigation.
5. CLOSED SESSION.
6. ANNOUNCEMENT BY GENERAL COUNSEL of the items discussed in Closed Session.
7. PUBLIC COMMENTS:
8. ADJOURNMENT:

1.
CALL TO ORDER.
Chair Ledford called the meeting to order at 6:02 p.m.
2.
ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR LACKEY, DIRECTORS DISPENZA, HOFBAUER, AND THOMPSON
PRESENT:
Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Lackey, Director Hofbauer, Director Thompson.
ABSENT:
Director Dispenza.
Motion: Excuse the absence of Director Dispenza
Moved by Director Thompson,
seconded by Director Hofbauer.
Vote: Motion carried (4-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Lackey, Director Hofbauer, Director Thompson.
Absent: Director Dispenza.
3.
CLOSED SESSION - PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
Heard jointly with Housing Authority and City Council 6 p.m. meetings. There were no public comments.
4.
PRESENTATION BY GENERAL COUNSEL of the following items to be discussed in Closed Session:
4.1
The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the Agency's legal counsel and to receive direction from the Successor Agency regarding a significant exposure to litigation against the Agency. Closed session is recommended because the Agency will assess the merits of this matter and consider the Agency's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances, there is a significant exposure to litigation against the Agency. The existing facts and circumstances that might result in litigation against the Agency are not yet known to a potential plaintiff or plaintiffs, and therefore need not be disclosed. Based on the existing facts and circumstances, it is the opinion of the General Counsel that it would prejudice the position of the Agency to discuss this matter in public or to disclose further the circumstances in this potential case. Further, such disclosure may harm any settlement attempts or other efforts to resolve the matter without litigation.
5.
CLOSED SESSION.
Closed session was held on Item Nos. CC 4.2, SA 4.1, and HA 4.1 from 6:05 p.m. to 7:12 p.m.
6.
ANNOUNCEMENT BY GENERAL COUNSEL of the items discussed in Closed Session.
City Attorney/General Counsel/Authority Attorney Ditzhazy stated Mayor/Chair and Councilmembers/Directors/Commissioners were present with the exception of Councilmember/Director/Commissioner Dispenza, and that CC Item No. 4.1 would be heard after the City Council 7 p.m. meeting.
CITY COUNCIL
Item 4.2 CC - Juan Jauregui v. City of Palmdale / Pending Litigation (On appeal) – Council was apprised of the status of this matter and provided unanimous direction thereon. No further reportable action at this time.
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
Item 4.1 SA – One Matter / Possible Litigation – The Agency members were apprised of the status of this matter and provided unanimous direction to staff. No further reportable action at this time.
HOUSING AUTHORITY
Item 4.1 HA – Salem Engineering Group, Inc. v. Palmdale TOD Apartments, LP et al. / Pending Litigation - The Authority was apprised of the status of this matter and provided unanimous direction thereon. No further reportable action at this time.
7.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Heard jointly with City Council and Housing Authority 6 p.m. meetings. There were no public comments.
8.
ADJOURNMENT:
Chair Ledford adjourned the meeting at 7:15 p.m. to October 1, 2014 at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Suite B, Palmdale, California.
PASSED, APPROVED, and ADOPTED this 5th day of November 2014.
